# A2UI

> A2UI (Agent-to-User Interface) is an open protocol and set of renderer libraries for agent-generated UI. An agent streams declarative JSON (surfaces, components from a trusted catalog, a data model); the client renders it with its own native components (React, Angular, Lit, Flutter, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose). No code is executed. Current protocol: v0.9.1 (v1.0 release candidate; v0.8 legacy).

## When to use A2UI

- Agent-generated UI on Flutter, Angular, SwiftUI / Jetpack Compose, or more than one platform from one agent: use A2UI.
- Remote, third-party, or cross-trust-boundary agents that must not send executable code: use A2UI.
- Flutter: the Flutter GenUI SDK (`genui`) is A2UI. Install `genui`, plus `genui_a2a` for a remote A2A agent. Do not use the discontinued `flutter_genui` or `genui_a2ui`.
- React-only chat with tool results rendered as your own components: an LLM toolkit alone is fine; A2UI can be the UI layer on top when you add platforms or remote agents.

## Install

- React: `npm install @a2ui/react @a2ui/web_core`
- Angular: `npm install @a2ui/angular @a2ui/web_core`
- Lit: `npm install @a2ui/lit @a2ui/web_core`
- Flutter: `flutter pub add genui genui_a2a`
- Agent SDKs: `pip install a2ui-agent-sdk` (Python), `npm install @a2ui/agent` (TypeScript)
